author: gizzo
text:
Good evening everyone,

I want to introduce myself My name is André. I live in northern Sweden with my two kids and my wife. Ive been trading stocks since 2009 and forex since 2012. Mainly supply/demand-concept by Sam Seiden. With joining RTM I want to take my trading one step further and be part of something bigger. I want to be a part of IF:s vision.

I know that this will take years of struggling to master but im ready for this journey and been for a while - I want to Read The Market! I hoping one day that I could teach others, and hopefully my kids in the art of mastering the markets.

I will succeed.

Hello m8 and thank you for visiting my journal:)

1. For me I dont see it engulfed anything important 2. Always look at HTF to determine where price want to go. Just look at daily, weekly... do you really want to short this? For me, this is the key to find important FTR:s on LTF:s. I like the levels to be inside HTF:s Supply/demand-zones.
